links.outcome: Accuracy of citations in ChatGPT responses to thyroid cancer questions
links.effect: 87.84% of citations referenced published medical literature, but 12.82% contained misinformation or errors.
links.quote: Notably, 87.84% of citations referenced published medical literature, but 12.82% contained misinformation or errors.

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses under different prompts (grade-level prompt vs none)
links.effect: Prompts tailored to a 6th-grade level generated the most easily understandable text, whereas responses without specific prompts were the most complex.
links.quote: Prompts tailored to a "6th-grade level" generated the most easily understandable text, whereas responses without specific prompts were the most complex.
